restated_task: Add an instance method `Version.is_compatible(other: Version) -> bool` to the Version class in src/semver/version.py. The method returns True when `other` (the new version) can be used in place of `self` (the old version). Compatibility rules: majors must be equal; new.minor >= old.minor; prerelease parts must be equal (both None counts as equal); patch is ignored. Major version 0 is special: only identical versions (major, minor, patch, prerelease all equal) are compatible. If `other` is not a Version instance (subclasses allowed), raise TypeError with message starting 'Expected a Version type'. Include a docstring with at least two doctest examples. Do not modify any other public behavior, tests, docs, or packaging; keep the existing pytest suite passing.

interface_contract.name: Version.is_compatible
interface_contract.behavior: Returns True when `other` (new version) can be used in place of `self` (old version). Compatibility rules: (1) self.major == other.major; (2) other.minor >= self.minor; (3) self.prerelease == other.prerelease (both None counts as equal); (4) patch is ignored. Special case: if self.major == 0, compatibility requires exact equality of major, minor, patch, and prerelease (build is ignored per semver spec). Subclasses of Version are accepted as `other`.
error_cases: TypeError: raised when `other` is not an instance of Version (or a subclass); message must start with 'Expected a Version type'

acceptance_criteria: Version(0, 1, 0).is_compatible(Version(0, 1, 1)) is False (major 0 requires identical patch)
Version(1, 2, 3).is_compatible('wrongtype') raises TypeError with message starting 'Expected a Version type'
Version(1, 2, 3).is_compatible({'a': 2}) raises TypeError with message starting 'Expected a Version type'
Version(1, 2, 3).is_compatible([]) raises TypeError with message starting 'Expected a Version type'
class CustomVersion(Version): pass; CustomVersion(1, 0, 0).is_compatible(Version(1, 0, 0)) is True (subclass accepted)
Method docstring contains at least two doctest examples
Existing pytest test suite (tests/) passes without modification
out_of_scope: Do not modify any other public methods, properties, or classes in src/semver/version.py
Do not modify any files in tests/, docs/, or packaging files (pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, etc.)
Do not change any existing public behavior of Version or other classes
Do not add new public APIs beyond Version.is_compatible
external_references_needed: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 specification (https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html) for compatibility rules
